openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: Marketed as an ADSL2+ Annex A router, but the hardware also supports VDSL2. Beside the wifi hardware, the router is very similar to the TD-W8970. OEM source code: http://www.tp-link.com/resources/gpl/GPL_TD-W8980.tar.gz. The 5GHz WAVE300 chipset is not yet supported by OpenWrt. Everything else should work.
openwrt_wiki.Bootloader: U-Boot 2010.06-LANTIQ-v-2.0.40-svn2583 (press t to enter U-Boot console on OEM firmware)
openwrt_wiki.Wireless: Atheros AR9287 2.4 GHz (2 internal) 802.11bgn + Lantiq WAVE 300 5GHz (3 external detachable) 802.11an
openwrt_wiki.Ethernet: 4x 10/100/1000 BASE-TX Ethernet Interface (2x XWAY VR9 GPHY 11G & 2x XWAY PEF7071 via RGMII)
openwrt_wiki.xDSL: Lantiq XWAY VRX208, ADSL1/2/2+ (G.992.1/3/5) Annexes A, B, I, J, M, L, VDSL1 (G.993.1, T1.424, TS 101 270), VDSL2 (G.993.2), ITU-T G 998.2 Bonding, EFM (IEEE 802.3ah)
openwrt_wiki.GPIO Buttons: WPS button, WiFi toggle switch, Reset button
openwrt_wiki.GPIO LEDs: ADSL, Internet, Wireless 2.4GHz, Wireless 5GHz, WPS, USB Port 1, USB Port 2
openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout (OEM, /proc/mtd): mtd0 boot 0x20000, mtd1 kernel 0x140000, mtd2 rootfs 0x660000, mtd3 config 0x10000, mtd4 romfile 0x10000, mtd5 rom 0x10000, mtd6 radio 0x10000
openwrt_wiki.Installation via OEM GUI: Firmware older than 12.10.2013: OpenWrt via firmware update in web interface; from 12.10.2013 the web interface accepts only RSA signed images (v3 header); U-Boot does not validate the signature, flashing over serial & TFTP still works
openwrt_wiki.Installation via Serial + TFTP: Open the case by removing the 4 screws on the bottom and unlock the 6 snap locks; remove the antenna nuts; the two cables towards the copper rails can be ignored. Turn the board. The 4 holes in the middle are the connections for the Serial Console (Fotos https://i.imgur.com/2eDYFOz.jpg, https://i.imgur.com/66IhgM9.jpg). Console 115200, login admin/1234, press 't' for U-Boot (VR9 prompt); sf erase 0x20000 0x7a0000
openwrt_wiki.WAN Port (User recipe): If you don't use ADSL you can use 3 lan ports and the other extra port for the wan
openwrt_wiki.Tags: Lantiq VR9 MIPS MIPS32 34Kc GigabitEthernet 1NIC 2WNIC 4Port ADSL2+ VDSL2 USB 2USB usb2.0 JTAG Serial 802.11abgn ath9k 5Ant DetachableAntenna 64RAM 8Flash ar9287 xway xdsl wlan

openwrt_wiki_w9980.Serial Console Informations: The pin header for the serial console is not populated. It has to be soldered onto the board. A usual 2.5mm J7 pin header will do the job. Bild media:tplink:td-w8980:td-w8980_serial.jpg
openwrt_wiki_w9980.Pins for TD-W9980B (from top to bottom): Rx, Tx, GND, VCC (3.3V) DO NOT CONNECT VCC!
openwrt_wiki_w9980.UART-Boot: Left R225 pad, bottom of the board, shorted to UART GND; (The image above works for W9980 and W9980B, but is reportedly different for the very similar model w8980)
openwrt_wiki_w9980.Restore: EEPROM size 8MiB; first 128KiB bootloader, last 256KiB not in any firmware download; rootfs 0x20000-0x7c0000
openwrt_wiki_w9980.Hinweis Reset: reset button resets the configuration (OpenWrt trunk); failsafe via WPS button

openwrt_wiki_foto_seriell.Beschriftung im Bild: Serial 3,3 V; RX <-, TX ->, GND, +3V3 (von oben nach unten an J7, Stiftleiste eingeloetet)
openwrt_wiki_foto_seriell.Bauteile im Bild: J7, R360, R361, TP9, U150 Zentel A3R12E40CBF (RAM)

openwrt_wiki_w8970.Hint: If you are soldering headers to the board, the GND point can be quite tricky because it is not drilled all the way through. There is a via marked GND3 closeby.
openwrt_wiki_w8970.Power Consumption @ 12.0V (Lab PSU): Bootup 0.21 A, Idle 0.43 A, Idle + Wifi 0.44 A, 100% CPU-load + Wifi 0.50 A, Idle + Wifi + DSL ?
